description: THE definition of the 'External Collaborators' business unit and the 'Spaarke External Collaborator' role (unified-access-control-r2 task 191d, #2179 design v2 section 3.2). Every systemuser flagged sprk_isexternal = true lives in this one business unit (a direct child of the root that owns no rows and holds no container) and holds this one role, assigned from this unit. The role reaches a lineage row only through a share: Basic depth on every lineage table, no Share, no Assign, no Delete, and no privilege at all on the 'never' tables. The unit's default team is the team-share target (191c) and must never own a row, hold a role, or hold a writer or Stored File field-security profile. scripts/Set-ExternalCollaboratorRole.ps1 reads this file (dry run, -Apply, -Verify); tests/Spaarke.ArchTests/ExternalCollaboratorRoleGuardTests.cs pins it to the lineage registry (SecureChildLineage). Do not copy it anywhere else.
howToExtend: A table added to SecureChildLineage (a root or a child) must be added here in the same change, either to 'lineage' (Basic only) or to 'never'. The ArchTest fails until it is.

'lineage' entries name the table and the access types it gets, always at 'lineageDepth' (Basic). Allowed access types: Read (required), Write, Append, AppendTo, Create. Never Delete, Share or Assign. The script resolves each privilege name from metadata.
'never' entries get no privilege of any kind. Removing a table from 'never' is an owner decision (ebilling 088, D-185, round 131, Q6 = a).

'platform' entries are non-sprk_ privileges by name, each at the LOWEST depth the privilege supports (the script checks it against metadata and refuses any other depth). They are the model-driven-app entry set, taken from the platform 'App Opener' role (Microsoft's minimum to run an app, read on dev 2026-11-11) with the changes listed in each reason.

'catalogs' entries are organization-owned sprk_ reference tables (Read and AppendTo only), whose only depth is Global. A user-owned reference table never goes here: it would need Deep or Global on a user-owned table (owner decision, see notes/task-191d-external-collaborator-role.md).
Then run: scripts/Set-ExternalCollaboratorRole.ps1 -EnvironmentUrl <url> (dry run), then -Apply (owner go, task 191i), then -Verify.
